title: LoginResponse
description: Response from a successful login attempt containing session token, audit trace, and snapshot anchor metadata.

session_token.description: Signed session token for subsequent authenticated requests.

actor_id.description: Actor identifier matching the authenticated identity.

audit_event_id.description: Audit event identifier for this login attempt (traceability).

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot anchor identifier for rollback to the pre-login state.
